response.justification: The candidate lacks critical required qualifications: no demonstrated experience with C programming in UNIX/embedded environments, no evidence of Linux kernel modification or embedded networking expertise, and no Japanese language proficiency — all non-negotiable for this role. His background is overwhelmingly in web/mobile stacks (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) with no exposure to MACsec, 802.1X, switch firmware, or embedded security systems.
strengths: Strong full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain complex open-source systems
Proven track record in DevOps, CI/CD, and tooling infrastructure
concerns: No C programming experience in embedded or UNIX systems as required
Zero evidence of Linux kernel analysis or network switch firmware development
No Japanese language proficiency — a mandatory requirement

key_factors.factor: Absence of Networking Security Tech Experience
